top_signals.title: Managed Instability: Why the Wars Against Iran and Ukraine Can Go On and On and On…
top_signals.summary:
The Iran war is beginning to resemble the Ukraine war in one important way. Operationally, the wars themselves are still very different — Ukraine is a large-scale ground invasion, while the Iran war is not there just yet. But their political logic after a failure to achieve a quick result is starting to look very similar. In both cases, a larger power expected its overwhelming military force to produce a quick political result. And in both cases, that expectation failed.The targeted state adapted, outside supporters helped it remain afloat, and both conflicts moved from the promise of a decisive outcome

top_signals.title: Boosting Bond Buybacks Is Tactical Move, Bullard Says
top_signals.summary: The US Treasury says it will be buying back more longer-dated debt, a move designed to stop the surge in long-end yields. Former St. Louis Fed President James Bullard says this seems like an important tactical move, but it won't change the fundamentals. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Bessent Boosts Debt Buybacks After Climb in Treasury Yields
top_signals.summary: The US Treasury unexpectedly announced it’s ramping up buybacks of long-dated government debt, taking the action in the wake of yields on such securities hitting the highest levels in years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Trump Dangles Keystone XL Revival as Canada Tariff Deadline Looms
top_signals.summary: Canada has won a three-day reprieve from President Donald Trump’s threatened 50% tariffs, but a final trade deal remains hung up on Canadian auto exports, leaving Washington and Ottawa until Friday to settle one of their biggest remaining disputes, Reuters reported on Wednesday. Trump added energy into the mix late on Tuesday, saying the 830,000-bpd Keystone XL oil pipeline “may be awoken from the grave” as part of an agreement.
